positions.description: Skills: Test Driven Development · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · Node.js · Spec-Driven Development · Agentic AI Development · Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) · Artificial Intelligence (AI) · GitHub · Application Programming Interfaces (API) · Redis · Software Development · Datadog · React.js · Public Speaking · Functional Programming · Git · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Kubernetes · TypeScript · Full-Stack Development · Terraform

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Co-implemented upgrade for breaking version of data schema; upgrade spanned entire stack (Postgres, Django, GraphQL, Typescript/React) and every feature. Completed by deadline, with no downtime, and with no known bugs. Presented project to entire company.

Tech led design and implementation of key application features: industry-first carbon emissions benchmarking tool, carshare monitoring, and demo data feeds. Each enabled a critical sales or marketing objective.

Proposed and facilitated team adoption of repository pattern for persistent storage that decreased database query bugs and increased optimization opportunities. Led shared engineering learning time on the topic.

Supported and developed other software engineers by providing coaching and mentorship.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Django · Test Driven Development · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · Python · Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) · GitHub · Application Programming Interfaces (API) · Redis · Software Development · React.js · SQL · Functional Programming · Git · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · GraphQL · Kubernetes · TypeScript · Full-Stack Development

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Designed, built, and maintained ETL processes, running in Airflow on GCP Kubernetes, between seven data providers and BigQuery; co-presented project to entire company

Proposed and implemented GDPR-compliant data backup process; currently running in GCP with >99% uptime

Originated and executed offboarding process for service account credentials; rotated over 50 credentials while using process as onboarding opportunity for two new developers
positions.insights: Skills: Test Driven Development · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · Node.js · Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) · GitHub · Software Development · SQL · Public Speaking · Functional Programming · Git · Kubernetes · Full-Stack Development · Terraform

positions.title: DevOps Engineer - PCEP Intern
positions.description:
Created reusable Python AWS cost-savings audit script; identified over $1,000 in yearly savings with first run

Designed Python monitoring script that generates PagerDuty alert when key service goes down; deployed via Ansible to multiple AWS regions, including China
positions.insights: Skills: GitHub · Software Development · Git · Amazon Web Services (AWS)

positions.title: Software QA Engineer - PCEP Intern
positions.description:
Planned and executed web application test plans using JUnit, JMeter, Selenium Web Driver, and Postman; presented to senior engineers on unit testing in Postman

Identified aspects of core API functionality not exercised by existing JUnit tests, leading to improved test coverage and API bug identification and remediation	

Determined that vendor software was not delivering promised service by building Python test script; resulting data enabled project manager to seek vendor resolution
positions.insights: Skills: Test Driven Development · Python · GitHub · Software Development · Datadog · SQL · Git

positions.title: Software Engineer - PCEP Intern
positions.description:
Built research grant software in accordance with US Federal Government rules;  was sole person able to analyze opaque business rules for complicated government form

Gave engineering department tech talk on space-efficient storage, applications, and manipulation of sparse matrices

Added new features to product in Java, JavaScript, and proprietary language; by end of internship, was third most knowledgeable engineer in the company about the product
positions.insights: Skills: Java · GitHub · Software Development · SQL · Public Speaking · Git

positions.title: TCSS - Computer Science Department
positions.description:
Assisted students in lab sections for CS162 and CS163, both individually and in groups 

Answered questions, debugged programs, and provided code/programming concept feedback

Evaluated student performance on proficiency demonstrations for CS162, CS163, and CS202

educations.fieldOfStudy: Concentration in Religion, Ethics, and Politics
